item.title: Problem of Scale
item.content:encoded:
Fenrir is described as 7.2 Mm long. His head is at least 1000km snout-to-neck. A bounding cylinder with height and diameter of 1Mm has a volume of ~0.785 (Mm)3, or 785 million billion cubic meters. If it were full of water it would have a mass of 785 billion billion kilograms (785E18). Even after correcting for Fenrir's head being smaller than the cylinder and less dense than water, it still has a mass on the order of E18 kg.

[UHEC-656] landed in the lower jaw of the entity, weighing it down and retracting the teeth from the baseline dimension.

This tale gives a UHEC's mass as fifteen tons. It could be five hundred tons and it still wouldn't be enough to make Fenrir even notice. It's roughly the same ratio as your entire body vs a single one of your cells.

I suggest making Fenrir considerably smaller in the alternate reality.

item.content:encoded:
No action was taken initially,

Starting with this clause is evocative, but not informative, and definitely feels like fiction writing. Rather it might be better to write this in chronological order, and note when during the crisis action was taken and by whom.

By the end of the day, the death toll was in the thousands.

A range of estimated casualties (or the number if known precisely at this point) would make this more official seeming.

Reports and video evidence came leaking in from several countries in the Northern Hemisphere of giant, stationary 'UFOs' in the sky.

This probably could be expanded a bit. When did these reports start? How were they leaked? Is anything being done to control spin? Is anything being done to control leaks?

Assessment Team-743 "Snow Blind" was deployed to study the anomaly.

When? By whom? Was there a security council meeting? Was the General Secretary briefed? What was the legal authority for this order? Remember this is the political part of the report, and politicians always want to know who to blame and how to CYA if it goes pear-shaped.

It was then that the team observed Foundation forces aboard the SCPS Quarantine performing their own investigation.

Probably should mention that they encountered the Quarantine first, and then what they observed the Foundation doing.

In general a clearer sense of the timeline would be good, it doesn't necessarily need specific times, but some sense of the length of the crisis and how quickly or slowly the responses and developments were would be good.

Jäeger Bombers

I still don't especially like this nickname, but I guess that's just me.

I want to like this, but there are a number of details that really don't work:

"Jäeger Bombers". This is a very boring name and probably not correct German. "Jager" means hunter, and also fighter aircraft. So I guess this means "Fighter-bomber", which is actually "Jagdbomber" in German. Or maybe it means "hunter bomber", which I don't get (they bomb hunters)?
The scale of the creature means that they brought toothpicks to a rocket fight. If tissue thickness scales with size, no conventional small-arms or even most artillery pieces are going to have any effect on this. You want to fight something like this with really big explosives (probably with penetrating shells; bunker-busters), FAEs, or even tactical nukes.
The M-82; I'm guessing this is the anomalous Barret .50 cal that I can't seem to find now. Maybe it would be better if the SCP article was linked, and if there was some more lampshading. Otherwise this is so woefully inadequate that it doesn't even make them look competent enough to look incompetent.
The shoot-to-kill order at the end is over-the-top ridiculous. Why would the GOC risk another Occult War, as well as offending the national governments that hold the pursestrings to both organizations, just to steal a toy from the Foundation? Have they tried asking if they can buy one? Or maybe reverse engineering their own? Even if they do want to steal it, that is a mission for covert operatives, it isn't a worldwide rule of engagement; that's just chaos.
